episode_summary: A quickfire “Little Fish” episode where Andrew, James and Anna share and riff on listener-submitted curios ranging from national anthems and tectonic drift to submarines, Zeppo Marx’s inventions, Ice Age London and a WWII carrot-estrogen plot. They wrap up by allocating bonus facts to Club Fish supporters.
